items.q: What if the AI makes a mistake?
items.a: That's why we start with a monitored pilot. Important actions need approval, every action is logged, and when the system is unsure it hands over to a person.
We work under GDPR, use only the data we need and choose providers with a data processing agreement. Where possible, data stays in the EU.

items.q: Do we need to change our software?

handoff.title: Build and hand over
handoff.steps: Talk and plan → Build → Hand over.
handoff.pay: You pay once. You get full access and the code. Maintenance is optional.
handoff.for: For companies that have someone technical on their side.

care.title: Build and maintain
care.steps: Talk and plan → Build → We maintain it every month.
care.pay: You pay for the build and a monthly fee. We make the changes.
care.for: For companies that do not want to deal with the site.

items.q: How long does a build take?
items.a: A typical business site is online in about 3 weeks once we have copy, photos and a clear brief. A larger shop or app can take longer — we say so in the quote, before we start.

items.q: What is the difference between the two ways of working?
items.a: Build and hand over: we make the site and give you full access and the code. After that, changes are yours unless you add maintenance. Build and maintain: we stay every month and handle the changes.

items.q: Can I switch from one to the other later?
items.a: Yes. You can start with a hand-over and add monthly care later. Or stop maintenance and take the site yourself. We explain the switch with no hidden terms.
Small copy and page changes, security, backups and help when something breaks. Larger new features are agreed separately. The basic plan is enough for most companies.

items.q: Do I write the copy and provide the photos?
items.a: Yes. You provide the business content — copy, photos, logo. We shape the site around it. If something is missing, we say so before we waste time.
Yes. 50% at the start, the rest before launch. Scope and price are clear before we begin.

items.q: Who owns the site and the code after I pay?
items.a: You do. After the final payment you get full access and the code. Nothing is locked on our side.

items.q: What if I am not happy with the design?
items.a: The quote includes two rounds of design revisions. We write down what we will change and we do it. If the scope grows, we say so before we continue.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Sofia?
items.a: Yes. We work with businesses across Bulgaria and abroad. We talk online, and we meet in person when needed.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Wavsy is a two-person web studio in Sofia, Bulgaria. We decide how the data you send us is used.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: From the enquiry form: name, company if you give it, email and/or phone, project type, and your message. If you write to us by email, we receive what you send.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Only to answer you — usually within 2 calendar days — and to do the work if we start a project together.

share.title: Who we share with
share.body: We do not sell your data. If you send the enquiry through WhatsApp, the message is opened there and follows WhatsApp’s own terms. Viber opens a chat without sending the form.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: We keep an enquiry while we handle it, then delete it, unless we work together and need it for the project.
